{{Quote|When I wish to read the ancient ''Sith writings''&hellip;I wear ''this''.|King Ommin, describing one of his Sith amulets|audio=OmminTalismanTotJ.flac|<ref name="TOTJA">[[Tales of the Jedi (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi'' audio drama]]</ref>}}
'''Translation talismans''' were [[Sith sorcery/Legends|magical]] [[Sith talisman/Legends|Sith amulets]] that allowed the wearer to read and understand the [[Sith (language)|language]] of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith species]] as though it were their native speech. [[King/Legends|King]] [[Ommin/Legends|Ommin]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] possessed one such amulet, which he allowed the [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Tetan]] heir [[Satal Keto/Legends|Satal Keto]] to use. When Keto put the amulet around his neck, he was instantly able to understand the text of a stolen [[Sith spellbook/Legends|Sith spellbook]] in his possession, something he was previously unable to do.<ref name="nadd2" />
